comment: Advisories `npm run audit:npm` (scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs) accepts at high severity. Each entry says which tree it lives in and why it cannot be fixed; the script fails when an unlisted high or critical advisory appears, and warns when a listed one has gone so the entry can be removed.

advisories.GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv: extract-zip symlink traversal, in the e2e dev tree only: pulled by WebdriverIO's tauri-service and every @wdio package above it, no fixed release exists, and nothing in a shipped build links it. Remove once `npm --prefix e2e audit` is clean.
advisories.GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3: extract-zip symlink-entry arbitrary file write, a second advisory against the same extract-zip <= 2.0.1 in the e2e dev tree only: same WebdriverIO path as GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv, no patched release exists, and nothing in a shipped build links it. Remove with that entry.
advisories.GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm: braces stack-exhaustion DoS on deeply nested patterns, in the e2e dev tree only: braces 3.0.3 is pulled by chokidar, the file watcher under @wdio/cli and mocha, and no patched release exists (<= 3.0.3 affected). It only expands glob patterns from the checked-in WDIO/mocha config, never user input, and nothing in a shipped build links it. Remove once a fixed braces ships and `npm --prefix e2e audit` no longer reports it.

review.trigger: Recheck on every WebdriverIO, mocha, chokidar or browser/driver downloader upgrade; remove each exception when its advisory no longer appears in either npm audit tree.
review.archive_sources: Only official browser/driver distribution endpoints selected by the checked-in WDIO/Puppeteer tooling (Google Chrome for Testing storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public and vendor distribution URLs). Do not set download mirrors or extract user-supplied archives. Run CI downloads on disposable workers without production credentials.
review.status: No patched extract-zip or braces release exists at review. This bounds accepted development-tool risk; it does not remediate the upstream vulnerabilities.
